name: SPT-CL J0441-4855 (Hubble)
blurb: SPT-CL J0441-4855, a massive, distant galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: sptclj04414855-hubble
story: Among the most massive distant clusters found by the South Pole Telescope, this crowd of galaxies was spotted through the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect. Hubble photographed it in a survey of hundreds of such clusters, to learn how their brightest galaxies grow and how often their gravity bends the light of galaxies behind them.

claims.text: Hubble imaged it in the SPT-HST Legacy survey of clusters found by the South Pole Telescope via the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect
The survey studies how brightest cluster galaxies evolve and the statistics of strong lensing
It is among the most massive distant clusters of the SPT-SZ survey
Program 15307 describes it as a high-redshift, rich cluster
SPT-CL J0441-4855 is an SPT-selected galaxy cluster
